dedupe_keys.name: passenger volume simulation on yamanote line in tokyo modeling commons netlogo circular railway passenger flow model

description: A NetLogo model of passenger flow on a circular commuter railway, set up for Tokyo's Yamanote Line and published on Modeling Commons. Contents: trains spread uniformly along a loop, stations at equal spacing, passengers generated at each station from a Poisson distribution with a user-supplied mean, and train capacity limits. Inputs are station volumes, number of stations (29 for the Yamanote Line), train interval, loop time (about 60 minutes), maximum train capacity and passengers per minute; an emergency switch stops the trains while passengers keep arriving. Outputs are passenger volume at two chosen stations and average waiting time. Producer: Xiaosong Yin. Coverage: a generic circular line, parameterised for Tokyo. Format and access: NetLogo 5.2.0 file (uploaded 10 June 2015, 4 versions) that runs in the browser or in NetLogo. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the author says it is a basic framework with fundamental characteristics only, and users must supply their own station data. Simulation uses: exploring capacity and disruption effects on a circular rail line. Related records: none identified.
